isometricprojection.ponder.occlusion_edi: The pillar hides the rear beam. Its upper TWO blocks must both be covered by the same beam endpoint.
First right-click the TOP pillar block A1: this block should be hidden.
Then right-click the beam endpoint B. This creates A1 -> B, meaning B covers A1.
Next right-click A2, one block below A1. One relationship alone leaves part of the pillar in front.
Right-click the SAME endpoint B again. Both A1 -> B and A2 -> B are needed.
The beam now covers both upper pillar blocks, completing the impossible triangle without changing its real structure.
Hold the editor to inspect A-to-B arrows. Sneak-right-click a linked block to delete its rules. Only valid projected top seams can be linked.
